resources.string: Choose a Folder on a Drive…
Pick the drive, then the folder recordings should go in.
No drives found. Check the drive is plugged in and shows in the box\'s own Storage settings.
This box won\'t let the app save in this folder. Try another folder, or another drive. An NTFS drive may need formatting as exFAT.

To save to any folder on a drive, Android needs \"All files access\" turned on for this app. On the next screen, turn on \"Allow access to manage all files\" for Nuvio + IPTV, then press Back. The app only uses it for the recording folders you pick.
This box has no screen for \"All files access\", so a folder on a drive can\'t be picked here.
Picking a folder on a drive needs Android 11 or newer. On this box, recordings can go to a drive in the list when Android gives the app a folder on it.
\"%1$s\" won\'t be offered any more. Recordings already in it stay on the drive but won\'t show in the app unless you choose the folder again.
